description: This file is a PHP source file for a web application module that manages the display of milestones related to test plans within the TestLink testing platform. It initializes page parameters, manages user permissions, and prepares data for rendering the milestones view.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used as a dynamic object container in various parts of the script.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used to assign data to templates and display views.

classes.name: milestone_mgr
classes.description: Manager class responsible for retrieving milestone data associated with test plans.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Class used to compute metrics related to test plan milestones.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing test project and plan identifiers and names from session variables.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI context object with test plan info, milestones data, and user permissions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies that the user has sufficient permissions to access test plan planning functionalities.
